TRAIN CV: 28,000/208,417 observations across 80 trips. Student-development: 19,160/19,160 observations across 10 trips.
Proxy labels: nearest reference-route segment + weak GPS-motion orientation; NOT supplied pointwise ground truth.
These scores are not comparable to the binary candidate-row charts. Edge Macro F1 classes are trip-qualified canonical directed arcs (namespace trip_id:canonical_directed_original_arc_id; class union includes reference-only and prediction-only roads) over the union of reference and predicted arcs. The categorical log score normalizes positive candidate probabilities within each observation; absent targets get zero mass and the floored variant includes candidate misses (19 of 19,160 student observations for the final model, floor 1e-7). Emission log score, not a calibration claim.
